title: RIIIVER JORDAN and Tiago Vega Releases Hot New Single, “Gettin It”
htmlContent:
American-based artist, RIIIVER JORDAN, comes together with Tiago Vega to make a perfect record titled “Gettin It” to show the magic of camaraderie in music and the soul that will make people keep coming back for more. Each moving part of this record is done at a high level, from the production to rhyming, to give the people that timeless feel that has made us all fall in line with their ever-growing fanbase.

Music has long been a thing that we can relate to due to the substance given by the artists, as well as the natural soul that has been put into the music that works in perfect harmony to make something that keeps us coming back for more. That is especially true for this new impressive release from RIIIVER JORDAN and Tiago Vega on the new song “Gettin It.”
